newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 8.22 pct at Italy lira repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 8.22 pct at Italy lira repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 10.5 trillion lire five-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 8.22 percent, compared with 8.53 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.26 percent against 8.55 percent at the last repurchase pact for 5.5 trillion lire and 15 days on September 16.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on October 1. The Bank said it received 35 bids of which 13 were met in full and one in part.
